newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 21.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Wednesday morning:
NEWS OUTLOOK:
** U.S. stocks surge after U.S. Federal Reserve left
interest rates unchanged at closely watched meeting of its policy-making committee
** The Delhi Stock Exchange has decided to delist more
than 1,900 companies, which accounts for 50 percent of the firms, for violating listing agreement, the Financial Express reports
STOCKS TO WATCH:
** Shares of tobacco conglomerate ITC is seen
taking a hit after the firm on Tuesday announced lower than expected profits.
ITC which is 31.7 percent owned by Britian's B.A.T.
Industries posted a 1996/97 (April-March) net profit of 3.42 billion rupees against 2.61 billion in 1995/96.
Traders said they had been expecting the profit of up
to 4.0 billion rupees due to stronger margins in tobacco.
** Rhone-Poulenc is due to announce 1996/97
annual results on Wednesday.
** Container Corporation is due to announce
1996/97 annual results
MARKETS:
** The Indian rupee INR= opened Wednesday at 35.795/80 per dollar little changed from Tuesday's close of 35.790/795, dealers said.
** Bombay's benchmark 30-share index .BSESN ended 10.01 points lower at 3,768.30.
** The National Stock Exchange index .NSEI was down 0.05 points at 1,050.85.
-- Bombay equities desk +91-22-265-9000
